items.title: Help with Setup, Optimization & Beyond
items.description: Whether you need help adding your first dish, advice on organizing your menu, or want to suggest a new feature — we're here. Every question matters, no matter how small.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our support.

items.question: Is support available on the free plan?
items.answer: Yes. Personal support is available for every plan, including free. We believe every restaurant deserves real help, regardless of their subscription.

items.question: How fast do you respond?
items.answer: Typically within a few hours during business days. We read every message personally and aim to resolve your question in one reply.

items.question: Can you help me set up my menu?
items.answer: Absolutely. If you need help adding dishes, organizing categories, setting up translations, or configuring reservations — just ask. We're happy to walk you through it.

items.question: Can I suggest new features?
items.answer: Yes, and we love it! Many of our features started as user suggestions. Message us with your idea and we'll consider it for future updates.
